title: Galgotias University Nearest Metro Station, Plus Sharda and GL Bajaj (2026)
meta_title: Galgotias University Nearest Metro Station, Sharda, GL Bajaj
meta_description: No metro is within walking distance of Galgotias University: Pari Chowk is 15 km by road, about ₹150-200 by auto. Sharda and GL Bajaj: 2.5-3 km.
excerpt: Galgotias University has no metro station within walking distance: from Pari Chowk it's about 15 km by road and ₹150-200 by auto. Sharda and GL Bajaj are 2.5-3 km from Knowledge Park II, and GCET about 550 m. Distances, fares and last trains, checked October 2026.

faq.question: Which is the nearest metro station to Galgotias University?
faq.answer: Pari Chowk and Knowledge Park II on the Aqua Line are about equally near: both are about 11 km away in a straight line, and from Pari Chowk it's about 15 km by road, around 17 minutes by car. No station is within walking distance. An auto from Pari Chowk costs about ₹150-200 and an Uber Go about ₹250 (checked October 2026).

faq.question: Galgotias University ke nearest metro station kaunsa hai?
faq.answer: Galgotias University ke paas koi metro station walking distance par nahi hai. Sabse paas Aqua Line ke Pari Chowk aur Knowledge Park II hain. Pari Chowk se university sadak se lagbhag 15 km hai, car se 17 minute. Auto lagbhag ₹150-200 leta hai, Uber Go lagbhag ₹250.

faq.question: Which metro station is nearest to Sharda University?
faq.answer: Knowledge Park II on the Aqua Line: about 3 km by road, around 7 minutes by car. Pari Chowk is next, about 3.7 km. In October 2026 an Uber Auto from Knowledge Park II cost about ₹59. Sharda University is in Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida, not in Delhi.

faq.question: Which metro station is nearest to GL Bajaj, Greater Noida?
faq.answer: Knowledge Park II: GL Bajaj Institute of Technology and Management's entry gate is about 2.5 km by road, around 5 minutes by car (2 km in a straight line). Pari Chowk is about 3.3 km by road. In October 2026 an Uber quote from Knowledge Park II to the neighbouring GL Bajaj College of Technology and Management was about ₹30 by bike and ₹118 by Uber Go.

faq.question: Is Galgotias College (GCET) the same as Galgotias University?
faq.answer: No. Both belong to the Galgotias group, but GCET (set up in 2000, affiliated to AKTU) is in Knowledge Park II, about 550 m by road from Knowledge Park II station, a 5-minute walk. Galgotias University (set up in 2011) is on the Yamuna Expressway, opposite the Buddh International Circuit, about 11 km further south.

faq.question: What time is the last metro from Knowledge Park II?
faq.answer: By NMRC's timetable, the last train towards Noida Sector 51 (for Noida and Delhi) leaves Knowledge Park II at 10:10 pm every day, and the last train from Sector 51 arrives at 10:35 pm. Check NMRC's train timings page on the day, as times can change.
